Admissions
Application Procedures for 2026-2027
Application Deadline is December 1st, 2026 (11:59PM PST or 2:59AM EST)
Application Material Check-List:
Online graduate admissions application
Statement of Purpose
Personal Statement
Resume/CV
Three letters of recommendation
One set of official transcripts: You will be uploading scanned or digitized copies with the online application. Official transcripts are also required to be sent electronically or via regular mail. (Applicants who have studied outside the U.S. - Official transcripts are only required if offered admission.) Electronic official transcripts must come directly from your Institution(s) Registrar and e-mailed to NeuroPhD@mednet.ucla.edu.
Or you may request to have official transcripts mailed to:
UCLA Neuroscience Graduate Office
695 Charles E. Young Dr. South
Gonda Center, Room 1506D
Los Angeles, CA 90095-1765
Effective Fall 2020: the GRE General Test is no longer required to apply for admission.
TOEFL iBT (For additional information, refer to the UCLA Graduate Education English Requirements Webpage): UCLA Institution Code 4837, Department & Major Code: 99
IELTS (in lieu of TOEFL): Official score report should be sent to the address listed above.
Selecting the Academic Program - Neuroscience PhD on the online application:
"Plans for Graduate Study" Section
Major - Select: Bioscience PHD - Neuroscience
Don't forget to provide Major and GPA information in the "Additional Academic Information" details section on the online application.
Only the required application items will be evaluated. Do not mail or upload any other supplemental documents or any duplicates of uploaded application items. Our program does NOT require a writing sample. Do NOT upload your publication(s) to the application site.
Pathway and Motivation for Graduate School (optional)
For further questions, please visit our Admissions FAQ Page.
For all other questions, contact us via email, Neurophd@mednet.ucla.edu.
Weekly virtual office hours will be held on Tuesdays, 3:00-4:00 pm PDT, via Zoom starting October 6th and ending on December 1st.
